findings.issue: `writhe` is defined in a `public section` without `@[expose]`, and there is no `writhe_def`. Downstream the writhe is a black box: only `writhe_mirror`, `writhe_empty`, `oneCrossingPositive_writhe` are usable, and no new code's writhe can be computed.

findings.evidence: Lines 157-164 and 189-194: only three of four, resp. two of four, fields are characterised; `ext` at 105-107 requires `hvisit hover hsign hpartner`.
findings.fix: Add `@[simp] mirror_partner : D.mirror.partner = D.partner`, `@[simp] relabel_over : (D.relabel e).over = D.over`, `@[simp] relabel_partner : (D.relabel e).partner = D.partner`.

Since `ext` (line 105) needs all four projections and the bodies are opaque, no downstream identity involving `mirror` or `relabel` can be proved.

findings.evidence: Lines 212-236: the only declaration mentioning `oneCrossingPositive` after its definition is `oneCrossingPositive_writhe`.
findings.fix: Add `@[simp]` lemmas `oneCrossingPositive_visit i = 0`, `oneCrossingPositive_over i = decide (i = 0)`, `oneCrossingPositive_sign c = .positive`, `oneCrossingPositive_partner = Equiv.swap 0 1`. For `empty`, add the uniqueness lemma `theorem eq_empty (D : OrientedGaussCode 0) : D = empty` (all fields are maps out of `Fin 0` and `Perm (Fin 0)` is a subsingleton).
findings.issue: `oneCrossingPositive` exports no field lemmas at all — `visit`, `over`, `sign`, `partner` are unreachable downstream (body opaque), so only `oneCrossingPositive_writhe` is usable of the file's one nontrivial example.

findings.fix: Drop `hpartner` from `ext` and prove partner equality inside it; add the uniqueness lemma `theorem eq_partner_of_visit_eq {i j} (h : D.visit i = D.visit j) (hne : j ≠ i) : j = D.partner i`.
findings.issue: `ext` demands `hpartner`, but `partner` is determined by `visit`: from `E.visit (E.partner i) = E.visit i` and `hvisit`, `D.same_iff` gives `E.partner i = i ∨ E.partner i = D.partner i`, and `E.partner_ne` kills the first. The extra hypothesis makes every downstream equality proof carry an obligation that is never independent. Relatedly, `partner_eq_of_visit_eq` (line 118) is documented as "the unique distinct visit" but only delivers the disjunction.

findings.evidence: Lines 88-94; `partner_partner` at 122-124 currently just restates the field.
findings.fix: Remove the `partner_involutive` field and keep `partner_partner` as a proved lemma; add `@[simp] theorem partner_symm (D) : D.partner.symm = D.partner`.
findings.issue: `partner_involutive` is derivable from `partner_ne` + `same_iff`: `same_iff i (partner i)` gives `visit (partner i) = visit i`, then `same_iff (partner i) i` gives `i = partner i ∨ i = partner (partner i)`, and `partner_ne` excludes the first. Every consumer constructing a code must discharge a redundant obligation. There is also no `partner_symm`, so `D.partner.symm` (produced by any `Equiv` rewrite) is unreachable.

findings.evidence: Lines 172-197: the only relabel lemmas are `relabel_visit`, `relabel_sign`, `relabel_id`; `writhe` (142) and `mirror` (146) have no relabel interaction.
findings.fix: Add `@[simp] writhe_relabel : (D.relabel e).writhe = D.writhe` (via `Equiv.sum_comp`), `relabel_relabel : (D.relabel e).relabel f = D.relabel (e.trans f)`, and `mirror_relabel : (D.relabel e).mirror = D.mirror.relabel e`.
findings.issue: The two operations in scope have almost no interaction API: no `writhe_relabel` (relabelling preserves the writhe — the roadmap product of this file), no `relabel_relabel`/`relabel_trans` composition law, and no `mirror_relabel` commutation. `relabel_id` alone leaves the action laws half-stated.

findings.fix: Either define the type as ± in terms of `ℤˣ`/`SignType` (Mathlib/Basic/Sign/Defs.lean:29), or add `instance : Neg CrossingSign` with `neg` as its `Neg.neg`, plus `@[simp] toInt_inj : toInt s = toInt t ↔ s = t`.
findings.issue: `CrossingSign` re-implements a two-element sign type with an ad-hoc `neg`, no `Neg` instance (so `-s` and all Mathlib sign automation are unavailable, and `CrossingSign.neg_neg` shadows `_root_.neg_neg`) and no bridge to `ℤˣ`/`SignType`; `toInt` has no injectivity lemma, so any sign equality must be proved by constructor case-split.

summary: Bodies are correctly unexposed, but the characteristic lemma set is incomplete: writhe has no `_def`, `mirror`/`relabel`/`oneCrossingPositive` lack projection lemmas so `ext` cannot be applied to them downstream, and the operations have no interaction lemmas. The `ext` lemma is also over-strong and one declaration is a verbatim duplicate of a field.
